text:
dmitri: quick RFC follow-up 12 noticed a bunch of fallbacks last night when regional cost signal flapped. can we decide on a debounce strategy? I can share logs.
alice: saw that too. looks like probes + cost calc jitter. spikes are usually <15s.
carla: yeah, common pattern: cost updates from cloud provider every few secs, our route score flips immediately.
matt: curious if we should debounce all signals or only cost-driven score deltas. latency SLOs hate waiting.
dmitri: proposal sketch: only debounce cost-origin changes (not latency/errors). window=10s rolling avg; emit telemetry flag when debounce suppressed.
alice: makes sense. treat error/latency alerts as immediate overrides. cost-only flips are safe to smooth.
carla: +1. also add a per-tenant multiplier: noisy tenants get longer windows. maybe cap to 60s.
matt: ops note: cache key impacts 12 the route-compat cache must include the debounce version so we don't serve stale compat entries.
ops-bot: heads up: created PR 4567 (feature flag policy_debounce_v1) > staging for initial test :robot_face: https://github.com/redwood-inference/policy/pull/4567
dmitri: rough DSL snippet for the RFC (draft):
```
policy "debounce-cost-v1" {
  match { signal == "cost" }
  action debounce(window="10s", method="rolling_avg", cap="60s")
  override if { signal == "latency" or signal == "error" }
}
```
alice: guardrail idea: if debounce causes median latency to increase >50ms for a tenant, auto-disable debounce and alert.
carla: I'll add metrics: route_flip_count, route_flip_rate, flip_latency_hist, tags: region, tenant, debounce=true/false.
matt: also record debounce_version in cache keys and compat entries. add migration note for config reload.
dmitri: plan: implement behind flag, run A/B on low-traffic tenants for 24h, review flip_rate and latency delta. if safe, roll to staging by weeks.
alice: follow-ups: carla -> metrics + dashboards, matt -> cache key changes and migration, dmitri -> update RFC text + add sim results, ops-bot -> keep PR/flag tracking. :thumbsup:
carla: filing dashboard prototype ticket now.
dmitri: thanks everyone 12 will update the RFC doc with the DSL and the perf sim numbers later today.
